blocks.text: Ezekiel 39 completes the Gog material of chapters 38–39: Gog of Magog leads a latter-day coalition against restored Israel, and the coalition is defeated by divine action. Questions about how this vision relates to the book’s larger sequence remain open. The familiar ordering places chapters 38–39 after chapter 37, but an ancient manuscript places them before it; the book’s broad divisions are useful for navigation without settling its chronology or composition.
